text_description: Full-length runway look in a black ground with large, painterly floral motifs in white, gray, ochre, and orange. The upper garment is sleeveless with strong, slightly extended shoulders and a very deep plunging V neckline reaching toward the waist, edged with irregular pale gray/silver embellishment or clustered trim that continues around the neck area. The bodice is close through the torso, then heavily draped at the waist with an oversized tied knot/bow at the front, creating wrap-like volume and layered fabric panels. Below, the silhouette becomes sculptural and asymmetrical: a matching floral black midi-length lower section or wide culotte-style layer falls to the lower calf, partially covered by uneven overskirt panels and ruffled flounces that project outward at the hips and sides, with pointed hanging fabric tabs and a longer trailing panel visible near one side. The print placement is bold and scattered, with large blossoms crossing the bodice, waist drape, and skirt/pant layers. Styling is minimal but ornate, with long dangling earrings and delicate barefoot-style foot jewelry or very fine sandals around the ankle and toe, leaving the feet mostly exposed. Overall mood is dramatic, deconstructed, and romantic, combining a plunging evening silhouette with voluminous tied drapery and irregular layered floral panels.
